# om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100

Stock update file OLY_E_148_1100_0000_0000.BIN, 90,832,896 bytes, with its SHA-256 from OMKit's pinned manifest.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md). **Advertised version:** 1.1. **Internal build:** 1100.

**Container SHA-256:** `9de5d77e1d290fa2ed4ebc7d75cee0ed490befbc89566722467d1d421d66d637`

SHA-256 of the official file as published by OMKit, whose firmware tool accepts the stock file only by this digest (docs and release/platforms/om5m2/fw1100/platform.json at a29db07). Not hashed by the Atlas.

## Technical reference

- [Take section bounds from the loader, not from 0xFF runs](../reference/hazard.ff-is-not-free.md): An 0xFF run in the file can lie outside the section load, so code placed there is never loaded.
- [Gate on section initialisation, not on the load request](../reference/hazard.ready-not-requested.md): A section's copy or load-request bit can be set before its constructors run.
- [Keep patch state out of the loaded firmware image](../reference/hazard.state-in-loaded-image.md): Stores into the loaded program image have restarted cameras; stock firmware does not make them.
- [Leave the compressed section holding the card updater stock](../reference/hazard.updater-section-stock.md): On the OM-5 Mark II the card updater is in compressed section 7; repacking it puts recovery at risk.
- [Free DRAM gap](../reference/om5-ii-1100.dram-free-gap.md): 3,383,948 bytes reserved behind the first resource record and unused by the firmware; OMKit loads CORE.BIN and modules here.
- [Picture editor setting read](../reference/om5-ii-1100.editor-read.md): Setting read used by the picture-mode editor.
- [FastEndCb hook site](../reference/om5-ii-1100.fastendcb-hook.md): Fast-startup callback that runs once per power-on about 1.2 s in, after the live picture; OMKit's one 5-byte hook.
- [Section ready bits](../reference/om5-ii-1100.ready-bits.md): Set after the decoder completes and the section's constructors run; what native section_wait reads.
- [Section requested bits](../reference/om5-ii-1100.requested-bits.md): Set when a section load request returns; for sections 6 and 7 only once the decoder has the job.
- [Section 2 tail filler](../reference/om5-ii-1100.section-2-tail.md): 832 bytes of 0xff filler inside the section 2 load; OMKit puts its trampoline and loader body here.
- [Section 5 loaded range](../reference/om5-ii-1100.section-5.md): Section 5 loads 0x60843000..0x60846000; the 4 KiB before section 6 is not loaded.
- [Section 7 loaded range](../reference/om5-ii-1100.section-7.md): Section 7, compressed in the update file, holds the card updater FIRMUP_CLI.
- [Section 9 flag word](../reference/om5-ii-1100.section-9-flag.md): Word outside the DbgSup range that section 9 reloads from flash at every power-on; OMKit's once-per-boot flag.
- [Section descriptor table](../reference/om5-ii-1100.section-table.md): Native descriptor table; with the end selector at 0x600463af it fixes each section's loaded range.
- [Update component kind dispatch](../reference/om5-ii-1100.update-dispatch.md): The card updater's dispatch on component kind.
- [White balance commit](../reference/om5-ii-1100.wb-commit.md): Setting-commit path for white balance; hooked by the per-profile WB work.
